dataset_id.description: Stable source collection identifier, e.g. deepmath_oss_93020.

source_question_id.description: Question/problem identifier from the local source file.

question.description: Problem text used as part of the retrieval key.

answer.description: Reference or official answer when retained in the skill-card source.

skill_text.description: Compact reusable skill card. Prefer Trigger/Do/Avoid/Check/Risk style content or the source heuristic field.

source_model.description: Model that generated the source trajectory or answer.

distill_model.description: Summarizer/distiller that produced the skill card.

representation_type.description: structured_skill_card, structured, drop_caution, free_summary, raw_cot, raw_example, etc.

source_path.description: Local source path used during packaging. This is for reproducibility and should be removed or documented before public upload if needed.
